Faran_About_1: Sannu! Muhammad Faran Aiki (8 ga Afrilu, 2007), ɗalibin Tsarin Bayanai da Fasaha (IST) a Makarantar Injin Lantarki da Informatics - Lissafi (SEEI-C), Cibiyar Fasaha ta Bandung, yana nan!
Faran_About_2: Dalibin da ya sadaukar da kansa ga Tsarin Bayanai da Fasaha a ITB tare da gogewar aikin injiniyan software a Analitica, koyarwar SAT a Kobi Education, lambar azurfa ta ONMIPA-PT 2026 a fannin Lissafi a Jami'ar Airlangga, da lambar yabo ta Paragon Scholarship Program Excellence 2025. Yana da tushe mai karfi na nazari da kwarewar ci gaban software na fasaha.
Faran_Philosophy: Sunan Faran Aiki ya fito ne daga kalmar Faran "ci gaba", yayin da sunan Aiki ya fito ne daga kalmomin Jafananci "ai" (愛) da "ki" (気) waɗanda ke nufin 'makamashin ƙauna'. Don haka, "Faran Aiki" yana nufin '(wanda ke) son ci gaba da cigaba'.
Faran_Principle_1: Yin alkawarin ƙauna, ba da ma'ana, kiyayewa, da daukaka (1) Allah, (2) Ilimi da Hikima, da (3) Sha'awar Ci gaba da Cigaba.
Faran_Principle_2: Tare da waɗannan ƙa'idodin a matsayin ma'auni don ci gaba da rayuwa, ina da tushe da tushe don kada in daina ci gaba ta kwanaki masu wahala.
Faran_Principle_3: Ko da yake wani lokacin ana karkata daga ƙa'idodin da ke sama, ban taɓa mantawa da komawa wannan tafarki da ya kawo shi har haka ba domin, a asali, mutane ba za su iya zama cikakke ba, amma zan iya ƙoƙarin kiyaye abin da ke jagorantar rayuwarsu.
Faran_Vision_Mission_1: Don zama mutumin da ke ci gaba da girma da haɓaka, kuma yana iya ƙarfafa ci gaba—ko na jiki, tunani, ko hankali—tare da duka, bisa ga ƙauna da tausayi da hankali da tausayi ke motsawa.
Faran_Vision_Mission_2: Tare da wannan hangen nesa, ina ƙoƙarin koyo ba tare da gajiyawa ba, kamar nazarin kimiyya, fasaha, da zamantakewa-humanities, da kuma yin tunani ta hanyar abubuwan da na samu ko na wasu don ƙirƙirar hanyoyin magance matsalolin da ke akwai.
Faran_Vision_Mission_3: Bugu da ƙari, ina kuma ba da fifiko ga dabi'un nagarta waɗanda aka yarda da su a ko'ina, a duniya, da kuma hankali. Ina yin haka ne don tabbatar da cancantan ma'anar sunansa, wanda shine ci gaba da cigaba, duka ɗaya bayan ɗaya da kuma a matsayin rukuni.

FAQ_Faran_Q1: Wadanne ayyuka Faran yake yi banda ci gaban manhaja?
FAQ_Faran_A1: Faran mutum ne mai hazaka da yawa wanda yake hada sha'awar sa ta rubutu, kida, da lissafi (mathematics). Ya wakilci ITB a gasar karshe ta lissafi ta ONMIPA-PT 2026 a Unair—shaidar sadaukarwar sa, yana tabbatar da cewa za a iya samun nasara ta hanyar juriya koda ba a taba cin OSN ba a baya.
FAQ_Faran_Q2: Za ka kwatanta Faran a matsayin mai ilimi gaba ɗaya ko masani na musamman?
FAQ_Faran_A2: Yana bin samfurin kwarewa na T-shaped: kiyaye zurfin ilimin fasaha a fannin Software Engineering yayin da yake kasancewa mai son sani da budadden tunani a fannonin fasaha da kimiyya.
FAQ_Faran_Q3: Shin Faran 'nerd' ne a ma'anar gargajiya?
FAQ_Faran_A3: Faran, wanda ya kira kansa 'nerd,' yana jin dadin koyo ta hanyar aikatawa da bincike na dijital. Ya fi son ginawa da fasa abubuwa a fannin dijital maimakon karanta littattafai kawai.

FAQ_Website_Q1: Waɗanne fasahohi ne ke tafiyar da wannan rukunin yanar gizon?
FAQ_Website_A1: An gina wannan rukunin yanar gizon ta amfani da Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, da TypeScript.
FAQ_Website_Q2: Menene wahayi a bayan wannan rukunin yanar gizon?
FAQ_Website_A2: Shugaban STEI-K 2025 ne ya zaburar da samar da wannan rukunin yanar gizon.
FAQ_Website_Q3: Yaya ake inganta aikin wannan rukunin yanar gizon?
FAQ_Website_A3: An inganta rukunin yanar gizon don babban aiki, cimma kusan cikakkiyar Core Web Vitals da ingantaccen SEO.
FAQ_Website_Q4: Shin wannan rukunin yanar gizon yana samuwa ga masu sauraro na duniya?
FAQ_Website_A4: Ee, yana goyan bayan harsuna fiye da 12 don tabbatar da samun dama ga masu sauraro na duniya.
FAQ_Website_Q5: Yaya ake sarrafa sirrin mai amfani a wannan rukunin yanar gizon?
FAQ_Website_A5: Rukunin yanar gizon yana girmama sirrin mai amfani tare da sifili mai sa ido ko tattara bayanai.
FAQ_Faran_Q4: Menene yake ƙarfafa ci gaban Faran na dindindin?
FAQ_Faran_A4: Domin shi ne ainihinsa na wanzuwa, ma'anar da ta yi daidai da ma'anar sunansa.
